evidence.description: Determine whether initial electron removal and subsequent benzylic hydrogen loss give the same or different mechanistic predictions across para-H, para-Cl, para-Me, para-OMe and para-SMe benzyl alcohols. Establish which trends are supported by molecular electronic energies and spin localization, and test whether a single descriptor is sufficient. This is a bounded molecular hypothesis test, not a calculation of catalytic yield.
